name: ring16_gopro_fisheye
description: ring16 geometry with the real GoPro fisheye calibration, so renders carry the distortion the physical rig produces and the localization path sees the same undistortion step a real capture does. Lighting comes from the scene, not from this spec: a rig spec describes CAMERAS. An earlier version carried a lights block that deleted the scene's own ring and substituted 12x150 W at 3.72 m, which is 5.85x the irradiance of the authored 8x100 W at 6.00 m and rendered the subject 2.55 stops hot.
